an1.278:1.1: bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā dve rājāno cakkavattī apubbam acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.278:1.2: Ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā eko rājā cakkavattī uppajjeyya ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjatīti. 12. Aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ
an1.279:1.1: bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ itthī arahaṃ assa sammā sambuddho n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.279:1.2: Ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puriso arahaṃ assa sammā sambuddho ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjatīti. 13. Aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ
an1.280:1.1: bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ itthī rājā assa cakkavattī n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.280:1.2: Ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puriso rājā assa cakkavattī ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjatīti. 14-16. Aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ
an1.281-283:1.1: bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ itthī Sakkattaṃ kāreyya . . . pe . . . Mārattaṃ kāreyya . . . pe . . . Brahmattaṃ kāreyya n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.281-283:1.2: Ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puriso Sakkattaṃ kāreyya . . . pe . . . Mārattaṃ kāreyya . . . pe . . . Brahmattaṃ kāreyya ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjatīti. 17. Aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ
an1.284:1.1: bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ kāyaduccaritassa iṭṭho kanto manāpo vipāko nibbatteyya n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.284:1.2: Ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ kāyaduccaritassa aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo vipāko nibbatteyya ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjatīti. 18. Aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ
an1.285-286:1.1: bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ vacīduccaritassa . . . pe . . . 19. Aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ manoduccaritassa iṭṭho kanto manāpo vipāko nibbatteyya n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.285-286:1.2: Ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ manoduccaritassa aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo vipāko nibbatteyya ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjatīti. 20.
